faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Lucknow Junior Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIM Lucknow Junior Manager position is 06-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/BE or M.Tech/ME/MCA (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Electronics from a reputed Institute/University with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for the Junior Manager role?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 1-2 years of relevant experience is required for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Manager post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 70,620/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Manager (Systems & Endpoint Engineer, Server, Data Center & Device Management) post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official IIM Lucknow website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, Skill Test, and Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
